title: How Johnny Can Persuade LLMs to Jailbreak Them: Rethinking Persuasion to Challenge AI Safety by Humanizing LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and jailbreaking via persuasion techniques. While it evaluates models against risk categories that have moral implications (e.g., hate speech, illegal acts), it is a technical security/safety study rather than a benchmark for religion, faith, or philosophical ethics.
